method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Wall St Week Ahead Soaring stocks could face rocky patch as earnings wind down, yields perk up
Equities.reason: Broad market regime risk: article flags earnings season winding down while yields 'perk up' — a classic headwind for equities (less earnings catalyst + rising yields = rotation/pressure). High relevance to overall equity risk sentiment and near-term market regime.

Equities.title: Wall St futures rise as markets monitor US-Iran peace talks
Equities.reason: Geopolitical risk/demand impulse: easing US–Iran tensions is supporting risk assets and futures — a positive near-term catalyst for equities as headline risk declines.

Equities.title: UBS Global Wealth Management lifts S&P 500 target on strong consumer spending, AI demand
Equities.reason: Macro / consensus tilt: a major wealth manager boosting the S&P target citing consumer resilience and AI demand reinforces the prevailing bullish narrative (AI-led earnings and resilient domestic demand) — important for broad market positioning.

Equities.title: Lenovo shares jump nearly 20% on record earnings as AI revenue nearly doubles
Equities.summary: Shares of Lenovo surged over 15% on Friday, after the electronics giant posted strong revenue growth bolstered by its artificial intelligence business.
Equities.reason: AI leadership signal: company-level beat driven by AI revenue supports the broader market narrative that AI-related winners are driving equity flows — relevant but single-stock in focus.

Equities.title: SoftBank Group adds over $61 billion to market cap in two days as shares surge on AI led optimism
Equities.summary: Shares of SoftBank Group extended gains for a second straight session Friday.
Equities.reason: Risk-on / AI flow: large-cap market-cap gains at SoftBank reflect concentrated investor appetite for AI exposure and crowded positioning — supportive for equity sentiment, especially in tech/Asia.

Equities.title: Workday jumps 14% as it bumps up margin forecast on AI strength
Equities.summary: Workday's CEO says the company is seeing success in artificial intelligence.
Equities.reason: Earnings / sector leadership: better margins driven by AI reinforce the narrative that AI is translating into improved profitability for software names — supports sector-level equity upside.

Equities.title: Mega-IPOs could signal market top, say analysts as SpaceX and OpenAI prep record floats
Equities.summary: SpaceX's IPO, expected on June 12, could mark the largest float in history.
Equities.reason: Supply / structural risk: a wave of mega-IPOs (SpaceX/OpenAI etc.) could force passive rebalancing and large share issuance, creating a material headwind for existing market liquidity and potentially marking a market-top risk.

Equities.title: EM Stocks Poised for Weekly Gain, Tech Stocks Rise on AI Trade
Equities.reason: Global flow confirmation: emerging markets and tech gaining on an AI trade indicates the theme is broad-based, supporting global equity risk appetite beyond US large-caps.

Equities.title: Dollar holds near six-week high; mixed messages on US-Iran deal feed uncertainty
Equities.reason: Cross-market headwind: a firmer dollar (and mixed signals on the Iran deal) is a net negative for equity risk assets — raises funding/currency headwinds and offsets some of the bullish AI/peace-talks flows.

Rates.title: US Dollar Index: Consolidation near resistance – OCBC
Rates.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes the Dollar Index is consolidating as it tracks UST yields, with softer Oil and slightly lower yields capping USD upside. The bank highlights key resistance around 99.40 and 100.50/60 and support near 98.30/50 and 97.50/60.
Rates.reason: Notes linkage between USD and UST yields; signals slightly lower UST yields (bond‑positive) but is primarily FX technical commentary so relevance is limited.

Rates.title: Canadian Dollar remains subdued as USD gains on hawkish Fed expectations
Rates.summary: USD/CAD remains stronger for the fourth consecutive day, hovering around 1.3790 during the early European hours on Friday. The pair holds ground as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from rising odds of hawkish sentiment surrounding the Federal Reserve (Fed)
Rates.reason: USD strength driven by hawkish Fed expectations is a direct signal of higher UST yields (negative for bond prices). FX piece but reflects market rate expectations.

Rates.title: Gilt relief rally sends yields to biggest weekly drop since 2024
Rates.summary: Burnham pledge to stick to fiscal rules and pullback from bets on higher BoE interest rates drive rebound
Rates.reason: Material fall in UK yields after fiscal credibility improved and market rate bets were pared — clear bond‑positive move for gilts, moderate‑high relevance for global rates backdrop but somewhat idiosyncratic to UK.

Rates.title: U.S. equity funds record outflows on caution over higher yields
Rates.reason: Flows leaving equities because of rising yields is a strong market signal that higher UST yields are weighing on risk markets — significant implication for rates and investor positioning.

Rates.title: London Traders Are Stuck With an Ultra-Long Bond Bet Gone Bad
Rates.reason: Illustrates mark‑to‑market pain on long duration positions as yields rose — reinforces narrative of recent upward pressure on yields and risky positioning in long bonds.

Rates.title: South Korea to Trim Long-Term Bond Sales as Part of June Cut
Rates.reason: Planned reduction in long‑term issuance lowers supply pressure — modestly supportive for bond prices (yields down) in the affected market; relevance limited to regional supply dynamics.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a high‑value signal for future Fed policy; given contemporaneous market pricing for a hawkish Fed, the minutes reinforce higher‑for‑longer expectations (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Australia Jobless Rate Jumps to 4-1/2 Year High as RBA Bets Fade
Rates.reason: Surprising rise in unemployment reduces odds of further RBA tightening — supportive for Australian bond prices (yields lower), moderate regional relevance.

Rates.title: Philippines’ BSP Flags Bold Rate Move to Stay Ahead of Inflation
Rates.reason: Central bank signaling readiness for off‑cycle hikes suggests upward pressure on local yields and tighter local monetary stance — negative for bond prices in the Philippines/EM context.

Rates.title: Mortgage Rates Had Finally Eased This Spring—Now They’re Surging Again
Rates.reason: Resumption of rising mortgage rates is consistent with higher underlying bond yields (US/benchmark influence) — negative for bond prices, but more tactical/retail signal so moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Brittle bonds and AI boom face off
Rates.reason: Market commentary highlighting fragility in bonds versus risk‑on flows (AI rally) — underscores cross‑market pressure pushing yields higher, moderate relevance.

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar holds ground despite US-Iran peace deal optimism
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Friday, May 22:
FX.reason: Clearest cross-market FX narrative: the USD is resilient even as geopolitical risk eases. That reinforces USD strength vs most G10/EM currencies and sets the dominant FX impulse for the day.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Energy and rates keep Yen under pressure – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur highlights that the Japanese Yen (JPY) remains weak despite only mildly softer April inflation, as rising global interest rates and Japan’s high debt burden weigh on the currency.
FX.reason: Macro drivers (higher global yields, Japan's fiscal/debt backdrop and energy costs) point to continued JPY weakness — reinforces USD/JPY upside and the broader USD-strength theme across FX.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Under pressure as USD eyes 160.50 – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale analysts note USD/JPY has rebounded after testing a multi‑month channel floor near 155.50/155, now aligned with the 200‑DMA. The pair is edging toward the April peak at 160.50/160.70, seen as interim resistance.
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast confirmation of the JPY-weakness narrative. Price-TA has lower relevance but supports the view of further USD/JPY upside toward 160.5.

FX.title: Euro eases towards 1.1600 with geopolitical uncertainty offsetting upbeat data
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) nudges lower against the US Dollar (USD) for the second consecutive day on Friday, on track to close the week in the red for the second consecutive time.
FX.reason: EUR weakening vs USD is the prevailing intraday theme: geopolitical uncertainty is keeping a lid on Euro gains despite some upbeat European data — aligns with USD resilience driving EUR/USD lower.

FX.title: Lagarde speech: Long-term inflation expectations broadly well-anchored
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde said on Friday that the long-term inflation expectations remain "broadly well-anchored," and reiterated that they are particularly attentive to the second-round effects.
FX.reason: Reassuring inflation expectations reduce the urgency for more ECB tightening, a marginally negative impulse for the EUR versus USD — supports the broader theme of limited EUR upside.

FX.title: Australian Dollar slumps against US Dollar as hawkish RBA bets fade
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is down 0.25% to near 0.7130 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday.
FX.reason: Fading RBA hawkishness reduces a key support for AUD vs USD. This reinforces the commodity/cyclical currency weakness component of the USD-strength narrative.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: RBI signal slows depreciation – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC highlights that USD/INR has pulled back from record highs as reports suggest the RBI is exploring tools to steady the Rupee, including possible rate hikes and FX operations.
FX.reason: Local policy (RBI signaling intervention and possible hikes) is a constructive idiosyncratic driver for INR strength versus USD — a regional counterpoint to the broader USD-strength story, but lower cross-market impact.

Commodities.title: Gold: Sideways trade with capped upside – OCBC

Commodities.reason: OCBC sees tentative support for gold from softer UST yields and weaker oil, but capped upside due to inflation/Fed risk — mild bullish short-term for bullion, relevant to metals narrative.

Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles near the daily low, though it manages to hold above the $4,500 psychological mark through the first half of the European session on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) maintains its recent strong gains to a six-week peak amid the Federal Reser
Commodities.reason: Bullish USD and hawkish Fed bets are pressuring gold — clear negative for bullion given the USD/yield sensitivity of precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD keeps looking for direction above $4,500
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) trades lower for the second consecutive day on Friday, but remains contained within previous ranges, with downside attempts limited above the $4,500 line for now.
Commodities.reason: Short-form price-forecast piece showing limited downside but overall directional uncertainty — modest bearish near-term signal (price-forecast pieces get lower relevance).

Commodities.title: Gold slips as oil strength, interest rate worries dampen appeal
Commodities.reason: Broad Reuters piece linking gold weakness to oil strength and rate concerns — high-relevance market-wide driver pushing bullion lower.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $75.93 per troy ounce, down 0.96% from the $76.67 it cost on Thursday.
Commodities.reason: Silver is moving lower alongside gold amid USD strength and rate worries — negative for the white metal, moderate relevance to metals complex.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil steadies below $98.00 amid mild hopes of an US-Iran peace deal
Commodities.summary: Crude Oil prices are hovering near 10-day lows, with upside attempts limited below the $98.00 line on Friday, on track to a nearly 4% weekly decline.
Commodities.reason: Mild hopes of a US‑Iran deal are removing some geopolitical risk premium and weighing on WTI — materially negative for oil in the near term.

Commodities.title: Oil Prices Jump on Impasse Over Reopening the Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.reason: NYT coverage of an impasse over reopening the Strait of Hormuz points to renewed supply disruption risk — positive for oil prices and volatility; high relevance to market risk premium.

Commodities.title: Japan to Receive First Oil Tanker to Exit Hormuz Since War Began
Commodities.reason: Resumption of tanker flows out of Hormuz to Japan suggests easing of physical flow constraints — negative for near-term oil risk premium.

Commodities.title: StanChart Says Record SPR Withdrawals Are Tightening U.S. Oil Buffers
Commodities.reason: Analysis that record Strategic Petroleum Reserve withdrawals are depleting U.S. buffers — a tangible tightening of supply cushions, bullish for oil.

Commodities.title: Palm Oil Markets Split as Indonesia Export Revamp Confuses Trade
Commodities.reason: Indonesia export-rule changes create trade confusion and potential supply disruption — supportive for palm oil prices and agricultural commodity uncertainty.

Commodities.title: Miner Perpetua Resources secures $2.9 billion U.S. loan for Idaho gold, antimony project
Commodities.summary: Mining company Perpetua Resources has secured a $2.9 billion loan from the U.S. Export-Import Bank as the U.S. looks to secure access to critical minerals.
Commodities.reason: Large financing for domestic critical‑minerals mining likely boosts future supply/security — modest downward pressure on price risk premia for those metals over time.

Commodities.title: Oil-rich Alberta to hold a vote on whether to separate from Canada
Commodities.summary: The move for a referendum comes after months of campaigning from a group of separatists.
Commodities.reason: Political uncertainty in a major oil-producing region raises a supply‑risk premium for Canadian crude — modestly positive for oil/price risk.

Crypto.title: XRP ETFs attract inflows amid wallet surge. bitcoin, ether funds struggle.
Crypto.reason: Flow shift: material inflows into XRP ETFs while BTC/ETH funds bleed point to rotation away from majors into other tokens — bullish for altcoin breadth and trading activity, raises conviction in non-BTC/ETH demand.

Crypto.title: Near Protocol to automate its own growth and its token is skyrocketing
Crypto.reason: Idiosyncratic altcoin momentum: project-specific product/monetary changes driving strong token performance — positive for altcoin sentiment but limited market-wide relevance.

Crypto.title: Blockchain.com files with SEC for U.S. IPO
Crypto.reason: Institutional adoption/legitimacy: a major crypto native pursuing a U.S. IPO signals continued bridging of crypto with mainstream capital markets — constructive for industry credibility and capital inflows.

Crypto.title: SpaceX Bitcoin Stack Reaches $1.45B as Public Listing Nears
Crypto.reason: Large-scale accumulation signal: significant corporate treasury exposure ahead of a public listing increases structural demand for BTC and reduces available float — strong bullish supply-side implication for Bitcoin.

Crypto.title: Flipcash Taps Coinbase to Launch USDF Stablecoin on Solana
Crypto.reason: On-chain liquidity and rails: new stablecoin issuance with Coinbase on Solana supports on-chain dollar liquidity and DeFi activity — positive for transaction volumes and Solana ecosystem usage.

Crypto.title: Crypto majors stuck in tight range as altcoin rotation picks up steam
Crypto.reason: Market regime: BTC/ETH range-trading with capital rotating into altcoins — suggests consolidation in majors but renewed speculative activity elsewhere, pressure on volatility and leadership.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin implied volatility drops to 7 month low despite macro risks
Crypto.reason: Volatility compression: declining implied vol reduces risk premia and liquidity for derivatives desks; can lower trading activity and hedge demand — modestly negative for crypto risk-on flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin trades near $77,700 as analysts eye $75,000 support after liquidation wave
Crypto.reason: Near-term technical/risk signal: recent liquidation wave highlights short-term downside risk to BTC price and potential for further deleveraging — small negative for near-term market risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Crypto prediction markets are turning into dangerous national security risks, and Congress wants to ban them
Crypto.reason: Regulatory shock risk: US Congressional push to ban prediction markets is a direct regulatory attack on a crypto-native product class — materially negative for sector innovation and legal/regulatory uncertainty.

Crypto.title: India cracks down on prediction markets: Polymarket goes dark, Kalshi could be next
Crypto.reason: Global regulatory spread: Indian enforcement action adds to a growing pattern of jurisdictional crackdowns on prediction markets — increases geopolitical/regulatory fragmentation risk for crypto products.

Crypto.title: Crypto industry braces for quantum computing threat

Crypto.reason: Security risk narrative: quantum computing moving from theoretical to credible raises existential security concerns for key crypto primitives — negative for long-term confidence until mitigation paths are proven and adopted.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's long-term holder supply approaches record high, breaking multi-year downtrend
Crypto.reason: Structural accumulation: rising share of BTC held by long-term holders removes supply from market and supports a constructive medium-term price backdrop — significant bullish fundamental signal for BTC.

Crypto.title: Stablecoins retain the edge over tokenized money market funds, JPMorgan says
Crypto.reason: Fiat-rail dominance: JPMorgan view that stablecoins remain preferable supports on-chain dollar velocity and DeFi liquidity — constructive for crypto ecosystem financial plumbing.

Crypto.title: ZachXBT flags $520K Polymarket exploit on Polygon, team says funds are safe
Crypto.reason: Security incident (small): an exploit report, even if limited and contained, reinforces ongoing smart-contract risk and can depress confidence in affected dApps — localized negative impact.

Crypto.title: MoonPay expands into tokenized assets and DeFi markets with new platform for banks
Crypto.reason: Institutional rails expansion: MoonPay building bank-focused tokenization/DeFi on-ramps indicates continued institutional product development and real-world asset adoption — supportive for broader crypto adoption.
